Within the gothic walls of an elite boarding school, a fragile alliance of scholarship students navigates a brutal hierarchy ruled by sadistic peers and complicit faculty. As deep-seated teenage trauma and crushing academic pressure push the group to a psychological breaking point, they orchestrate a dangerous, high-stakes rebellion against the institution's corrupt administration. When their explosive uprising exposes the school's darkest secrets, the students must decide how much of their own humanity they are willing to sacrifice for freedom.
